headline: Google opens Gemini 4 Carbon to broader developer, enterprise and research access
summary: On Nov. 10 Google announced broader access to Gemini 4 Carbon after an earlier limited cyber-defender release. The new post describes paid developer and enterprise access, a staged Google AI Ultra subscriber rollout and expanded research access, while reporting coding, cyber and scientific results. Carbon’s model card and safety report are now inspected: Google says its Frontier Safety Framework found no material capability change over Argon and carried forward Argon’s prior threshold determinations, while also noting higher cyber benchmark scores and strengthened cyber misuse safeguards. These are provider-authored assessments, not independent reproductions. This review did not test API access or reproduce benchmarks.
